candidates.reason: Directly covers the media-result path the PR changes: MediaPipeline._process_request (scrapy/pipelines/media.py:180,200) and _cache_result_and_execute_waiters (scrapy/pipelines/media.py:281-283), where the 100 ms await _defer_sleep_async()/call_later(_DEFER_DELAY, ...) becomes _process_pending_io() plus immediate waiter callbacks. The module also does `from scrapy.utils.defer import _defer_sleep_async` (line 20) and calls it in test_wait_if_request_is_downloading (line 446), so it necessarily breaks/needs updating when the helper is renamed to _process_pending_io.

Unit tests for scrapy/utils/defer.py, the module where the 100 ms helper lives (_defer_sleep_async, scrapy/utils/defer.py:89) and is replaced by _process_pending_io() (two sleep(0) yields). Any unit test for the new helper, or adjustment of the existing defer/awaitable helper tests, would land in this file.

Covers the scraper code path where the PR removes the sleep 'before every callback': Scraper.call_spider_async (scrapy/core/scraper.py:315) awaited _defer_sleep_async() before invoking every request callback/errback; this test drives that path through crawler.crawl_async and the Scraper error handling.

End-to-end crawl tests that exercise callback scheduling (sync/async/async-generator callbacks and errbacks) through Engine -> Scraper -> SpiderMiddlewareManager, i.e. the timing-sensitive path that no longer includes the 100 ms sleep before each callback.

Exercises DownloaderMiddlewareManager.download_async except-branch (scrapy/core/downloader/middleware.py:84), one of the call sites where _defer_sleep_async() is replaced by _process_pending_io(); these tests assert the process_exception/process_response ordering that the removed delay influenced.

Crawler-driven tests of SpiderMiddlewareManager.scrape_response_async and its exception recovery path (scrapy/core/spidermw.py:227), where the PR swaps the 100 ms sleep for _process_pending_io() before _process_spider_exception.

Direct unit tests that call SpiderMiddlewareManager.scrape_response_async (the exact coroutine whose except-branch sleep is removed in scrapy/core/spidermw.py:227), covering process_spider_exception return values and output chains.
